slides.headline: CRYPTO KEYS AND MEDICAL RECORDS SURFACED ON GOOGLE
slides.body: Reddit users discovered cryptocurrency wallet keys, API keys, and login credentials sitting in public search results. Some conversations held clinical trial data and internal company documents. Others exposed contact information for primary school students

slides.headline: ANTHROPIC BLAMED ITS OWN USERS FOR THE LEAK
slides.body: Anthropic told TechCrunch that users misused Claude's "share chat" button, which creates a public link anyone can open without logging in. The company said shared links "are not discoverable unless people share them themselves". But once a link lands anywhere public, Google's crawlers index it automatically

slides.headline: THE SAME LEAK HIT CHATGPT LAST YEAR
slides.body: ChatGPT had the same leak in 2025 — the second time in 12 months private AI conversations showed up on Google. Security experts say the real flaw is old: Dropbox, Google Drive, and Pastebin all hit the same wall years ago. An unguessable link is not the same as a protected one

slides.headline: ONE BUTTON LEAKED EMPLOYEE REVIEWS AND CLIENT DATA
slides.body: Companies pasted internal documents, employee reviews, and client records into Claude — then one click made them searchable by anyone on Google. The right AI setup keeps every conversation locked inside your company, with no shared links and no data leaving your walls — without adding a single step for your team
